source.integration: The accepted five-file candidate was applied to clean root tasks-hub. Its changed-file content is identical to the candidate. The separate narrative-history candidate remains unchanged and unreleased.

diagnosis.cause: Every Bugs/Features refresh replaced the actual .work-items-main scroll element during active motion, disconnecting the browser scroll target and focused control. Absolute offsets also could not retain a reader against inserted or resized rows.
diagnosis.baseline: On clean d102ab0, the isolated in-memory fixture reproduced active wheel DOM/focus replacement in Bugs and Features on Chromium and Playwright WebKit, four cases total.
diagnosis.correction: The view retains its exact scroll DOM through wheel, scroll and touch activity, coalesces the latest repaint after 120 milliseconds of idle, restores the first visible item/offset and focused row action, and interrupts stale filter contexts. Shared view focus restoration uses preventScroll for WebKit.
diagnosis.evidenceLimit: Wheel input is Playwright browser automation, browser smooth scroll is a momentum surrogate, and touch events are synthetic. No physical input, native Safari, owner trace or owner-device pass is claimed.
